targets.rawSql: select count(*) value from (select distinct on(connector_name) connector_state,failed_tasks from observability.connector_status_history order by connector_name,observed_at desc) s where connector_state<>'RUNNING' or failed_tasks>0
select count(*) value from (select distinct on(dataset_name) layer,status from observability.freshness_history order by dataset_name,observed_at desc) s where layer='bronze' and status='stale'
select distinct on(connector_name) connector_name,connector_state,total_tasks,failed_tasks,observed_at from observability.connector_status_history order by connector_name,observed_at desc
select observed_at as time,failed_tasks as value,connector_name as metric from observability.connector_status_history where $__timeFilter(observed_at) order by observed_at

select distinct on(dataset_name) dataset_name,round(age_minutes,1) age_minutes,sla_minutes,last_record_at,status from observability.freshness_history where layer='bronze' order by dataset_name,observed_at desc
